{{Top|leg}}
The '''HiBaka 2000 mem-stik''' was a type of [[Mem-stik/Legends|mem-stik]] that was designed to store data for transport. It could hold a moderate amount of data, but it was unable to carry programs. It could hold text, image or video data and could also hold under one minute of [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] data. It cost 50 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] new.

It was often used to covertly smuggle data, and a popular hiding place was inside the [[Blaster power pack/Legends|blaster power pack]] slot for a standard [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. While this helped conceal the mem-stik from detection, it prevented the blaster from being operational.
